summary: Completed e2e testing of PGSaathi v3 new features: 1) Email OTP verification during registration, 2) Attendance-based mess billing, 3) Visitor management with fines. All 22 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend pages verified - registration OTP flow, login OTP handling, visitors page, allows_visitors toggle in property form all working correctly.

issues: Console warning: hydration error due to <span> nested in <option> and <select> - cosmetic React warning, does not affect functionality
Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent} - accessibility enhancement recommended

critical_code_review_comments: OTP Flow (Email verification): Registration creates unverified user, OTP stored in MongoDB otp_codes collection, verify-otp validates and returns token, resend-otp works for unverified users only
Login OTP Flow: Unverified users receive OTP on login attempt and must verify before getting token
Meal Attendance: Admin can mark/overwrite attendance, tenant attendance marking blocked for duplicate meals, attendance summary correctly calculates per-meal rate
Visitor Management: Property allows_visitors flag controls visitor request ability, admin can approve/reject/fine visitors, tenant cannot perform admin actions
Bulk Invoice Integration: Visitor fines (status='fined', fine_billed=False) are included in bulk invoice generation with fine_billed flag updated
Notification System: Fine imposition triggers notification to tenant

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all new feature pages load and function correctly)

seed_data_creation: Tests create and cleanup: properties with allows_visitors flag, tenants, mess configs with attendance tracking mode, meal plans, attendance records, visitor requests with fines. All test data prefixed with TEST_
context_for_next_testing_agent: PGSaathi v3 features fully tested. OTP verification working (OTP stored in db.otp_codes collection). Meal attendance with per-meal billing working (tracking_mode='attendance'). Visitor management with fines integrated into bulk invoicing. Use TEST_owner_v2@pgsaathi.com/Test@1234 for owner access. To test OTP, read OTP from MongoDB otp_codes collection.

otp_auth: Registration creates unverified user with requires_otp=true
OTP verification returns token on correct OTP
Resend OTP works for unverified users
Already verified user cannot resend OTP
Login for unverified user returns requires_otp with OTP sent
Login for verified user returns token directly
meal_attendance: Admin can mark attendance for tenant
Attendance summary with per-meal rate calculation
bulk_invoice: Bulk invoice includes unbilled visitor fines

frontend_features_verified: Register page shows OTP input fields after registration
Login page handles OTP flow for unverified users
Properties page has Add Property button with allows_visitors toggle
Visitors page shows with status filter buttons (All, Pending, Approved, Rejected, Fined)
